enable_degraded_mode.detail: Synchronous fraud scoring disabled, orders flagged for async review. Checkout confirm p95 610ms, 504 rate 0.1%. Risk traded: ~4% of orders need manual review.
enable_degraded_mode.lesson: Trading synchronous fraud scoring for an async review queue restored checkout immediately.
enable_degraded_mode.reusable_lesson: When fraud-scoring-eu is degraded, enabling checkout-web degraded mode (async fraud review) restores checkout p95 to under a second within a minute. This is the correct mitigation for a third-party timeout; a restart or rollback is wasted time.

isolate_dependency.detail: Circuit breaker fully opened for fraud-scoring-eu: calls fail fast, retries stop, and the fallback path returns immediately. Same end state as degraded mode with a smaller code change.
isolate_dependency.lesson: Failing fast on a dead provider is equivalent to bypassing it, and needs no release.
isolate_dependency.reusable_lesson: Opening the circuit breaker for a timing-out third-party provider cuts checkout latency immediately (8.1s -> 0.7s) because requests fail fast into the fallback instead of waiting on 8s timeouts plus retries.

increase_timeout.detail: Raising the provider timeout from 8s to 12s made it worse for customers: 38% of checkouts now take 12s instead of 8s, and the 504 rate barely moved (5.4% -> 5.9%).
increase_timeout.lesson: Increasing a timeout against a dead provider converts fast failures into slow failures.
increase_timeout.reusable_lesson: Never raise a client timeout to 'fix' a timing-out provider: with fraud-scoring-eu timing out at 38%, raising the timeout from 8s to 12s increased checkout p95 to 12s and did not reduce 504s. Bypass or fail fast instead.

restart_api_pool.detail: Restarting checkout-web workers had zero effect: the provider is still timing out, so new pods time out identically. 6 wasted minutes.
restart_api_pool.lesson: Restarts cannot fix an external outage.
restart_api_pool.reusable_lesson: Restarting checkout-web did nothing during the fraud-scoring-eu outage: 504s and 8s latency were unchanged because the fault is external. Check the dependency graph before restarting anything.

rollback_recent_deploy.detail: Rolling back to the release from three days earlier changed nothing measurable and cost 12 minutes plus a rollback. Deploy correlation requires a deploy inside the incident window.
rollback_recent_deploy.lesson: Rolling back an unrelated release is superstition, not diagnosis.
rollback_recent_deploy.reusable_lesson: Rolling back checkout-web v3.4.1 (deployed 3 days earlier, outside the correlation window) had no effect on the fraud-scoring-eu outage. Only treat a deploy as a correlate when it landed inside the incident window.

flush_cache.detail: HIGH RISK and pointless here: flushing session cache logs out every in-flight shopper. Blocked by the safety gate.
flush_cache.reusable_lesson: Flushing the checkout session cache during a third-party outage logs out every shopper and changes nothing about the provider fault.
